priorities.summary: Authentication bypass in the JSON API Auth WordPress plugin via cached session cookie disclosure in all versions up to and including 3.1.2, letting unauthenticated attackers hijack sessions. Update the plugin immediately; no public exploit confirmed yet.

Missing authentication in Mooncake (through 0.3.13.post1) HTTP metadata server /metadata handler, allowing unauthenticated attackers to read, overwrite, and delete transfer-engine metadata keys. Upgrade Mooncake; the flaw is directly reachable without credentials.
Improper access control in Apache Traffic Server affecting 9.0.0–9.2.14 and 10.0.0–10.1.3. Upgrade to 9.2.15+ or 10.1.4+; reverse proxies and CDN edge nodes running ATS are the exposed surface.

model.name: Google Gemini 4 Argon
model.summary: Google's first Gemini 4 generation model, announced Sep 30 by Google DeepMind. Built for sustained deep reasoning across coding, legal/finance knowledge work, and defensive cybersecurity; it is the first production model with a 1-million-token output limit, rolling out first to trusted cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program (a guardrail-free tier) before paid API and Google AI Ultra subscribers.
